verdict.rationale: Firstbase explicitly offers a Registered Agent service with compliance dashboard tracking deadlines/state requirements, plus a mailroom that scans and digitizes mail into PDFs, which covers receiving legal mail digitally. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm service-of-process handling specifically or independent corroboration of mail scanning quality/timeliness. Missing for 10: explicit mention of service-of-process handling, independent/hands-on review of registered agent mail scanning experience.
